scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fabrica/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @fabrica/api" "npm run dev -w @fabrica/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fabrica/contracts && npm run build -w @fabrica/api && npm run build -w @fabrica/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fabrica/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fabrica/api && npm run typecheck -w @fabrica/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
